commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.

88' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andriy Lunin intercepts the ball.

79' That's unlucky! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Ath Bilbao earn a corner.

78' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Andriy Lunin pulls off a comfortable save.

65' The resulting corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.

41' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
39' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Julen Agirrezabala was alert and made a comfortable save.
39' The resulting corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
37' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
34' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Julen Agirrezabala.

28' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.

23' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Great teamplay by Ath Bilbao as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
14' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
12' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
10' The foul by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) was seen by Javier Alberola Rojas who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
10' A raking crossfield pass from Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

5' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
